'''Deyer''' was one of three habitable, but inhospitable, [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]] of the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]], located in the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It was a colony world consisting primarily of [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] and was composed of floating raft [[City/Legends|cities]], including the city of [[Feiya]], and [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] lakes. It featured abundant aquatic life.

==Description==
Deyer was the fifth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Anoat (star)|Anoat]] in the [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]],<ref name="TEA" /> situated on the [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Corridor]]<ref name="TEA" /> and located within the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]], which was part of the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was a cool, terrestrial world<ref name="JAS" /> with no [[Moon/Legends|moons]],<ref name="TEA" /> a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], and standard gravity. Swamps and lakes were its primary terrain. Its rotational period lasted 28 [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]] and its orbital period lasted 389 local [[Standard day/Legends|days]].<ref name="JAS" />

==History==
Settling Deyer a generation before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the colonists were promarily a co-op of [[fish/Legends|fish]] [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] who created a peaceful, anarchistic [[Politics/Legends|political]] system and exported fish along the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]].<ref name="TEA" />

It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kyp Durron]].<ref name="TNEGtC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>

The settlers flourished until they spoke out against the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]]s invaded the planet, wiping out the cities in a brutal military takeover and taking many prisoners.<ref name="TEA" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Deyer in the [[Churba sector/Legends|Churba sector]], which is actually located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].
